source_manifest: 01_赛题与原始数据/数据结构清单.json
approved_action: none until the two team members approve this version, exact window IDs and permitted action

windows.purpose: existing second oxygen interval; excludes 376 s event; keep both gases
existing second interval; outside recorded internal zero windows; keep both gases

alignment.oxygen: observed ΔO/0.5 in m³/s, timestamp at later original node; preserve original sequence and pair with gas at that node; reject negative increment or unresolved gaps
alignment.gas: original rate at matching nodes; no physical clock alignment implied
alignment.historical_reference: difference of cumulative O (m³ per interval) versus difference of gas rate, older positive-only lag scan with varying overlap; archive comparison only

reporting.units_threshold: same numerical thresholds for predeclared diagnostics; gas and oxygen feature standard deviation use m³/s for levels/detrended and m³/s change per original sampling step for difference
reporting.status: report profile, provisional peak, support, score margin, effective excitation and exclusion reason for each diagnostic; if primary sign or lag is not reproduced within 1 s by both diagnostics, label sensitivity disagreement; no physical transport claim even if they agree
reporting.scope: two windows in different heats; do not fit a delay-flow relation or claim causality
reporting.comparison: do not choose a method from held-out profiles or integrate this scan with continuous reconstruction before separate approval
